meaning.en: Holding the noose that is desire itself
meaning.hi: राग रूपी पाश धारण करने वाली

explanation.en: In one hand she holds a pāśa, a noose. The name says what the noose is made of: rāga, desire and attachment, the force that binds.

inner.en: The noose is attachment, the rope that binds every being to the world. In her hand the same rope becomes the bond of love that draws the devotee to her.

story.en: Names 8 to 11 describe her four emblems: noose, goad, sugarcane bow and flower-arrows. This is the form in which she is worshipped in Śrīvidyā.
